bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/ (retained views, Stack, Form, ScrollView), springboard/ui/src/ (stack, table, collection, sidebar, constraint)
summary: BifrOSt has an imperative, retained-view toolkit with stacks, grids, forms, scroll views, source lists, tables and animation, plus Auto Layout style constraints. It has no declarative View protocol, modifier chain, state-driven body, shapes or custom Layout protocol.

features.note: retained imperative views, no declarative body or modifier chain

Environment values with scoped overrides, typed reads and a with_value modifier for one subtree work and are tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs. Gap: the model is not wired into the shell or apps, and views still take their properties on each view instead of reading a generic modifier chain; the lab machine is needed only to confirm a shell view reads the environment on Midget.
a few fixed styles per control, no style protocols

springs and timing curves exist; Window::animate animates frame, opacity and background for any change made inside it (headless_swatch_is_drawn_where_the_animation_has_moved_it, headless_underdamped_spring_passes_its_target_then_rests_on_it in springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs); animation is opt-in per closure, not tied to state changes; no matchedGeometry
text fields and text layout; no Text formatting views or TextEditor parity checked
Symbol glyphs draw headless into an offscreen surface (springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-w7.rs); no AsyncImage or Image resizing modifiers
toggle, stepper, progress, picker; fewer than SwiftUI's set (no DatePicker/ColorPicker views checked)
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. menu model exists; no Commands builder

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no Shape protocol or Path trim/stroke API for apps
glass/vibrancy materials in renderer; no blur, shadow, mask modifiers or Canvas for apps

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/stack.rs (stack, distribute, grid, adaptive_columns, overlay, first_fitting); springboard/ui/src/lazy_stack.rs (visible_rows, visible_items, content_height: the lazy list and grid windows)
features.note: Stack and grid layout as pure functions: HStack/VStack spacing and flexible items, the four fixed distributions, adaptive columns, grid, a ZStack-style overlay and a ViewThatFits-style first_fitting. The SDK Stack view arranges its children with stack and distribute. Lazy list and grid windows (the rows or items under a viewport, with overscan) are tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs. Gap: no SDK view yet builds only the visible rows of a lazy stack or grid, so the windowing is not wired into the Stack view. Tests: spare_space_is_shared_by_flexible_items_in_proportion_to_their_weight, equal_centering_keeps_the_centres_equally_far_apart, adaptive_columns_fit_as_many_minimum_cells_as_the_width_allows, a_grid_fills_rows_left_to_right, an_overlay_aligns_each_layer_to_the_anchor, view_that_fits_picks_the_first_candidate_that_fits_the_constrained_axes (springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs)

features.feature: Layout adjustments (alignment, spacing, padding, safe area)
features.note: Insets, alignment, distribution, constraints with priorities, layout guides and hugging and compression priorities are solved headless (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-31.rs). Gap: there are no baseline alignment anchors.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/layout_protocol.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/layout_protocol.rs (FlowLayout) via Arrange in springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 6 (b15, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. constraint solver exists, no Layout protocol or AnyLayout transitions Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. source list, card grid, diffable snapshots; no generic List with swipe actions or edit mode
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. columns, sort descriptors, header hits; no TableColumn builder

forms with sections, split view; no TabView, GroupBox, ControlGroup views Built 2026-10-17: TabView selection model (ui tab_selection::TabSelection: select, remove with successor selection, duplicate ids dropped); tests tab_selection::tests in springboard/ui/src/tab_selection.rs. Not yet a TabView view, not wired into the shell or apps.

scrolling with model; scroll targets work headless: offset_for_rect places a row at the leading, centre or trailing edge of the viewport, clamped to the scrollable range, and ScrollView::reveal applies it (ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-05.rs). Still missing: a scroll position binding to app state and per-item scroll identity, and the reveal path has not run on Midget. Headless tests: ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (a_short_drag_does_not_scroll_and_a_tap_is_reported_as_a_tap, a_drag_follows_the_finger_past_the_slop, pulling_past_the_end_rubber_bands_beyond_the_maximum, jumps_and_range_changes_clamp_the_offset, a_released_bounce_springs_back_to_the_edge, a_fling_decelerates_and_stops_below_the_threshold).

features.feature: Shader effects (Shader, ShaderLibrary, colorEffect, distortionEffect, layerEffect, visualEffect)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/shader_library.rs (shader function table model); springboard/ui/src/effect_shader.rs (ShaderEffect: colorEffect, distortionEffect, layerEffect and visualEffect bound to a fragment function with checked uniforms); springboard/gpu/src/shader.rs (Vulkan shaders, not app-facing)
features.note: The four effect modifiers are modelled and validated against the library (the function must exist and run in the fragment stage, and the uniforms are checked), tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs. Gap: the per-shader inventory is pending the macOS 27 Golden Gate 26A434 extraction (InstallAssistant.pkg, docs/macos-os-inventory.md), and no effect runs in an app until a GPU pipeline is built from it, which needs the lab machine.

Layout protocol and ZStack, lazy grids, ViewThatFits
